commands.command: Current-GitHub-documentation research (2026-09-16): GitHub App user-authorization web/OAuth flow with PKCE, the token-exchange client_secret requirement, refresh-token client_secret requirement outside device flow, device-flow constrained/headless guidance and phishing caution
commands.summary: Confirmed a public/native client cannot keep any embedded value confidential; GitHub's web-flow token exchange requires client_secret regardless of PKCE; GitHub genuinely supports code_challenge/code_challenge_method=S256/code_verifier on the authorize and token-exchange steps; device flow is documented as intended for constrained/headless clients and carries a user-code-phishing/remote-impersonation risk when enabled without that justification. This is the evidentiary basis for Decision 0062.

commands.command: New rust/crates/repopact-provider-github/src/callback.rs: CallbackListener, a one-shot loopback listener bound to 127.0.0.1:<ephemeral-port> only
commands.summary: 10 unit tests against real local sockets: a real callback request is received and answered with the success page; a wrong-path request (e.g. favicon.ico) is answered 404 but does not terminate the wait; cancellation stops the wait; a timeout with no request reports TimedOut; an oversized request line is rejected and non-terminal; binds only to 127.0.0.1 (asserted via local_addr().ip().is_loopback()); each listener gets a fresh ephemeral port. The listener never echoes code/state/a token/any GitHub response data into its HTML page.

commands.command: Rewrote rust/crates/repopact-provider-github/src/provider.rs: GitHubProvider::start_browser_authorization (session generation, listener bind, URL construction, background worker) replacing the device-flow begin_authorization/poll_authorization implementation; GitHubProviderConfig gains public_client_secret and app_slug fields
commands.summary: A monotonic session generation counter, checked by the background worker before committing any result, ensures a superseded (retried/cancelled) session's late-arriving callback or exchange result can never overwrite a newer session's state -- proven by retrying_never_reuses_the_previous_sessions_state_or_verifier and cancel_stops_the_session_and_a_later_callback_is_ignored. GitHubProviderConfig's Debug impl prints only whether the secret is configured, never its value.

commands.command: 13 new negative callback-attack tests in provider::tests (real loopback sockets, real GitHubProvider) covering wrong state, missing state, missing code, GitHub error callback (mapped to AuthorizationDenied), cancellation with a later callback ignored, retry-never-reuses-a-session, a second callback on an already-consumed session; plus callback::tests' listener-level oversized-request/wrong-path/timeout coverage
commands.summary: Every negative path asserted no credential is stored (credentials.get(&access_token_key()).is_none()) and no token-exchange HTTP request was sent (form.received_requests().is_empty()) -- proving fail-closed behavior at both the credential-store and network-call level, not merely a returned error code.
